title: Choose NorAI's one visual world
question: The roll assigned The Stacks. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. To keep the current notebook look across the app instead, say so in the steer box.

options.label: The Stacks
options.lineage: University library stack signage and spine labels
options.thesis: Every part of a lecture gets a shelf mark you can walk straight to.
options.viewport: A library-green rail lists chapters as call-number ranges; notes on white carry a spine label at each section; the tutor's citations are spine labels that seek the video.
options.risk: Tips into library costume (wood, card drawers) if the world reaches past type, colour and the label.

raised.raise: Each study mode owns one full-strength zone colour, the way library floors are colour-coded.
Flat colour only: no paper grain, noise or graph-paper texture anywhere.
Destructive actions stand alone, never beside a primary action.
Timestamps and counts sit in strict tabular columns.

options.label: Highlighter & Index Cards
options.lineage: The exam-week revision kit: printouts, highlighters, index cards
options.thesis: NorAI highlights what matters the way you would the night before.
options.viewport: White notes with the passage the tutor quotes swiped in fluorescent; each study mode takes its own highlighter hue in the tabs.
options.risk: Fluorescent fields glare at night and in dark mode; closer to familiar study-app territory.

options.label: Catalog Wall
options.thesis: Your library as rows: keep studying, due today, by course.
options.viewport: Study home with a 'Keep studying' row and a 'Due today' row; the focused lecture tile grows to show its chapters.
options.case: Wins audience identification (everyone knows 'continue watching'); loses clarity on long reading in the notes.
options.risk: A dark poster wall fights hour-long reading, and leans on YouTube thumbnails NorAI does not control.

options.label: Exam Board
options.lineage: Airport departure boards and boarding passes
options.thesis: What to study next, ranked by when it is due, changing in place.
options.viewport: Study home as a board: each row a lecture with cards due, quiz score and next action; a changed row holds its yellow until seen.
options.case: Ranking by time fits the exam crunch home; loses audience identification on the reading surfaces.
options.risk: Travel costume if split-flap theatrics leak into the notes and tutor.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Each section a coloured board under clear acetate leaves.
options.viewport: Notes on acetate over a section-coloured board with a fore-edge tab rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: students do not know boxed-software manuals.
options.kept: Each study mode owns one full-strength colour.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.viewport: Persistent tiled panels for notes, video and tutor.
options.case: Fuses poorly: students are not developers, and it is the predictable opposite of cream.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.viewport: Chapters as map lobes around the notes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a study workspace is not a place to wander.
options.risk: Playful to the point of unserious.

options.label: Datamatics
options.viewport: Transcript density as a barcode field.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What AI study tools ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A grey sidebar, white notes, an indigo primary and a chat panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
